title: Zapatillero Black Crown Duster - Black Crown
description:
BLACK CROWN DUSTER SHOE BAG - The best way to transport your padel shoes inside the padel racket bag. This shoe bag has been designed to solve one of the most common problems of the padel player: transporting the padel shoes comfortably and without dirtying the rest of the equipment. It is a simple, practical and very useful solution both inside the padel racket bag and to use it independently.

On an aesthetic level, it combines an elegant black design with red details, providing a sporty and modern style.
